What the gold price today means for buyers

The spot gold price changes continuously during trading hours. But for most retail investors, what matters isn't the minute-by-minute tick — it's whether today's price represents a good entry point relative to recent history.

GoldAlert's approach: instead of predicting where gold will go, track when it has been falling for 3 or more consecutive days. These short-term pullbacks have historically been followed by positive average returns over the next 5–20 trading days. The signal status above shows today's reading.

Gold price today in other currencies

Gold is priced globally in US dollars, but the price in your local currency depends on the USD exchange rate. For a full breakdown of how gold price varies by currency, see our guide: Why the Gold Price Differs by Currency.

For gold prices in EUR, GBP, AUD, and CHF, see: Gold Price in EUR, GBP, AUD, CHF — A Guide.

How to convert gold price to grams and kilograms

The standard gold price quote is per troy ounce (31.1035 grams). To convert: divide by 31.1035 for price per gram, or multiply by 32.1507 for price per kilogram. Use the free gold calculator to convert automatically.

Frequently asked questions

What is the gold price today?

The current XAUUSD spot price is shown in the live chart above. Gold surpassed $4,000 per troy ounce in 2026, setting multiple successive all-time highs. The exact price changes during trading hours.

Is today a good time to buy gold?

GoldAlert's signal tracks whether gold has been falling for 3 or more consecutive days — a rule-based pullback indicator. The signal status card at the top of this page shows today's reading.

What is XAUUSD?

XAUUSD is the trading symbol for gold in US dollars. XAU is the ISO currency code for gold (from the Latin aurum). The price represents how many dollars one troy ounce costs.

How often is the price updated?

The TradingView chart above updates in real time during market hours. GoldAlert's buy signal updates once daily after the market close, using the official daily closing price.
